result.summary: This PR adds a new unit test, orphan_reconsideration_interruptible, to denialofservice_tests.cpp that verifies ProcessOrphanTx reconsiders at most one orphan per ProcessMessages() call. It exercises a scenario with six orphaned children (half with invalid signatures) reconsidered after their parent is accepted, checking the orphan pool and mempool sizes step by step. The author states this closes a gap where no existing test covers CVE-2024-52914 and demonstrates the test kills two specific mutants (removed 'return true' statements) using a mutation-testing harness.
result.problem: There is currently no test guarding against regression of CVE-2024-52914, a disclosed orphan transaction DoS vulnerability where more than one orphan could be reconsidered per message-processing call. Without this test, a future refactor of ProcessOrphanTx could silently reintroduce the vulnerability.
